Physical Release Studio

GOG Disc Creator · Build a classic PC game CD/DVD edition.

No upload. No account. Everything is processed locally in your browser. The trusted launcher is built into this page.

Privacy: Your GOG installer is never uploaded to this website. The browser reads the file locally and places it directly into the package you download.
1. Game
No installer selected
Select the GOG setup EXE. If GOG supplied .bin files, select the EXE and all matching .bin files together. The files stay unchanged. They are never uploaded: the browser reads them locally and writes them into your disc folders.
2. Cover & Disc
Optional
Optional
The preview keeps the original aspect ratio. The entire image is used; it is no longer cropped into a wide banner.
3. Extras (optional)
Choose local files such as manuals, soundtracks or artwork. They are added to the disc package locally.
4. Media & Disc Splitting
Select the installer and target medium to calculate the number of discs.
Normal mode: every .bin stays whole on one disc. Setup starts from Disc 1 and asks for the next disc when it needs it. Large .bin files: if a single .bin is bigger than the medium (typically CD-R), it is cut into parts and the launcher copies all discs to the hard drive before setup starts.
Burning: Burn the contents of each folder Disc 1, Disc 2, … to its own disc. Use UDF (or ISO9660 + Joliet), never plain ISO9660 level 1. README_BURNING.txt lists suggested disc labels. Disc 1 contains GOGAutoLauncher.exe. If AutoPlay is disabled, open the disc and double-click it.
